title: Evaluating Research Dataset Recommendations in a Living Lab

bias_targets.methodology: Analyzing the distribution of user clicks across different ranking positions (Figure 3) to demonstrate that datasets ranked in higher positions are clicked more frequently, confirming the presence of position bias in the live evaluation.

Qualitative evaluation of the system's re-ranking feedback loop, which boosts previously clicked items. The authors identify that this mechanism introduces popularity bias by reinforcing the visibility of already clicked items, potentially harming long-term results.
